notes.title: Dev Update #10 - Rugby Sport Showcase
notes.content:
Rugby, or for our American fans - American football, is the showcase of the final Squishy Sports sport mode that we want to share with you! Although Rugby and American Football are different sports our version of this awesome sport mode takes the concept of hitting the ball over the post to score a goal - a similarity between both sports!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/4ad8f642c8e9b1403563949d32a38ae3b39f4d2a.gif[/img]

This sport brings more vertical gameplay to Squishy Sports - as does Basketball! The main difference between the two modes is the scoring area! Whilst Basketball demands accuracy from players, Rugby has a large score area! This makes the sport mode a little bit more accessible to players as they find themselves smashing the ball over the bar to see their score increase! In the high-level play, experienced players will need to consider using their double jump and directional dashes to stay airborne and block goals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/2d6bd3e425af89fb29ede697646f06dd48380d2e.gif[/img]

Another feature that makes this sport mode feel different from others is the ball itself - it’s EGG shaped! This combined with the different character shapes means that the way you interact with the ball will feel different and perhaps more unpredictable! Players will need to take this into consideration when placing their shots, picking their characters, and special moves! Is your opponent trying to keep you grounded with a bear trap? Counter that with a devastating Tornado to kick everything up in the air!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/9cd241ec9d2ede2f0f22d5b34e502c753002ce02.gif[/img]

And that brings us to the end of our sports showcases! We hope you’ve enjoyed this insight into our sports modes to learn about how and why we designed these! Stay tuned for more posts that deep dive into more aspects of our game and art design!

Thanks for reading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/38334debfd7f50611aa2fcac43e96cecc7c5b2ea.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update #9 - Table Tennis Sport Showcase
notes.content:
Table tennis or Ping - pong is one of those super addictive sports in real life and we thought it would be a great addition to Squishy Sports! Rather than using bats players smash themselves into the ball to return it - this keeps continuity across all of our sports modes! In this post, we will talk about how we made this feel different from other sports modes and how we put our own Squishy spin on this classic sport!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/61ff95443636485db2664936c988781480151b84.gif[/img]

Table Tennis plays very similar to Volleyball but it is a little bit more accessible for less experienced or younger players! This is due to the addition of the table occupying a lot of the play space! The scoring area is roughly half the size that it is in volleyball meaning it’s a little harder for your opponents to score and it’s easier for you to return. This adds a safety net for players and makes it a much more accessible sport to jump into and almost acts as Volleyball “easy mode”! This means players can focus on getting those exhilarating volleys going a little bit more easily!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/be07a7ea5468d7d9de990aa85598a129275bdc22.gif[/img]

Our Ping Pong ball is our smallest ball and feels different to bash around than any other ball! This recreates the same fast-paced nature of Table Tennis you get in real life! However, in our version of this sport we players can stand on the table - because why not?! We thought this would be really fun and give players an option to play more offensively whilst potentially leaving their scoring area open in a risk-reward fashion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/6172b93ba73a6a2bca4e5435a765afb24a7de3bb.gif[/img]

The smaller scoring area means that you can think really carefully about what special move you are going to use! Below you can see Heart placing a cake mine on their side to act as a safety net and save themselves from losing a point! Player choice of shape and special move is one of the core parts of our design and we are super excited to see how players use all the tools we have given them in creative ways when we launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/07a2899364b2284e9fc1c54f1eedd8c3224c64ee.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoyed this insight into the design of our Table Tennis sport! Whilst on the surface it can seem similar to Volleyball - under the hood there is a lot more going on that makes this sport stand strong on its own! 

Thanks for taking the time to read about our Game Design on this sport - stay tuned for more sports showcases and other features soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/fe16397eb52438a0db13a443801e72c84153fcf4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update #8 - Basketball Sport Showcase
notes.content:
Basketball was the third sport mode that we developed for the game and this really added a whole new dimension to the way players play the game! In Volleyball and Football, you were largely playing a horizontal focussed sport with large goal areas. Basketball introduced much more verticality and more precision in aiming. The goal areas are much smaller so players need to get the right arc and power on the ball in the hope of landing a perfect slamdunk!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/0f0d9e2e9c0aa7065515b94ead78144e45669787.gif[/img]

We often see a lot fewer goals in this game mode, however, the intensity builds as the ball stores more velocity! (explained in our Volleyball showcase post!) The anticipation of the goals builds player excitement and the ball pings around the scene like a pinball machine, squishing anything it comes into contact with! This creates really heated matchups and again gives that great euphoric result when a player does manage to score!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/c601eecd1074f62add28d453b0cbc1f5148b3c24.gif[/img]

To help players with the precise there is some ‘code magic’ centered around the goal area that essentially helps the ball into the net if you hit it into the right area! This will be unnoticeable to players, however, if it wasn’t there you would be frustrated at the actual level of precision you would need in reality. We want our players to have a positive experience so we worked carefully on this bit of ‘behind-the-scenes’ magic, testing regularly with players to make it just right so that those Basketball games feel fun to score in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/dfff898c7180dab843523bf406b2283848087f04.gif[/img]

Below you can see the initial prototype of this sport mode! There are actually quite a lot of changes that have been made to this early prototype. We actually raised the goals significantly to really drive up that level of verticality in Basketball’s playstyle! It shows again how our core concept and design of characters can be experimented with in new ways to create a representation of a Sport that everyone is familiar with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/b6dc2fbf772bec9d218754dda245b9df2cd10eac.gif[/img]

Again in this sport mode, you will need to think about what character has the best shape for your playstyle to help hit the ball vertically and arc into the hoop! Do you prefer rounded characters like Circle, Heart, or Egg; do you prefer characters with angled edges like Triangle or Trapezium or do you prefer the flatter edges of Hexagon or Square? Think about these carefully as well as what special move might help pick up for your shape’s shortfalls!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/3f41c31fc74dd881fb5ca03a3fd4ac3713939a6b.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoyed reading a bit more about the design of Basketball sport mode and how we designed this to bring variety to the sports collection that is - SQUISHY SPORTS! 

Stay tuned for more showcase posts soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/1f1369bd429f0ef9ab78e17e18f47b84048631a6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update #7 - BALL CANNON!
notes.content:
We’ve just announced our latest special move - BALL CANNON! This is a powerful special move that allows the player to fire another ball into the scene! This now means that players have multiple balls to score with! It has one of the longer charge times of the special moves we have available so you will need to find the best moment to throw this curveball at your opponents! 

What ball will it launch in? Well, this is completely random too! You could end up with a regular bouncy beach ball, a smaller table tennis ball, an egg-shaped ball, or any number of secret odd-shaped balls we haven’t shown yet! =D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/e4eb9dffefbf05c181752c868d6ca8d583c436ac.gif[/img]

Is your opponent playing really defensively? NO PROBLEM! Launch another ball at them to split their focus! Keep the pressure on and it is only a matter of time before a ball goes in! Just remember there are more balls that could come your way too! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/ebfba26224760646479af185791075d0763058e0.gif[/img]

Ball cannon can be super powerful on Volleyball and Tabletennis modes as it launches the ball straight down! The ball cannon chooses between 3 spawn locations when you initiate it so it could just as easily fire on your side of the net too! You better be ready to defend your side when you’re about to fire in case his high-risk-reward special move in case it backfires! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/a6bc7ed44c674db7eaf7bcab6b880e5c027c67e4.gif[/img]

Once you’ve chosen your character shape you will be able to choose your special move; one of our core design pillars to allow players to balance their own play styles! Players can think carefully about what sports mode they are in, what their character shape’s advantages and disadvantages are, and then finally decide which special move they can use to give them the best shot at victory! As we mentioned previously all special moves have an element of risk-reward to balance them so this is something players will need to consider when picking their setup! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/6d485de0dd791d4793917339f0a6c11789951c9f.gif[/img]

So there we have it - BALL CANNON! Our new special move! Get ready to crank up the intensity in any match and force you and your opponent to think differently! We hope you like this and are ready to pressure your opponents with this incredible special move! 

Thanks for reading - more news on new special moves coming soon . . . :D[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/e4eb9dffefbf05c181752c868d6ca8d583c436ac.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update #6 - Volleyball Sport Showcase
notes.content:
[h3]Inception[/h3]

Volleyball was actually the first sport that we took from the initial prototype to a fully fleshed out sport for people to play! Volleyball was the best sport to explore with our 2d focussed gameplay and we quickly found that building up a volley between 2 players felt really fun! Our simple control system had you focussing on returning the ball as the intensity builds with each impact. When that ball finally hits the ground on the other side you feel that immense sense of victory of a volley well played as your opponent has their head in their hands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/801a39c87a6eace9447ac29c175d23575b2934a1.gif[/img]

[h3]Ball Velocity[/h3]

We absolutely loved the intense rush of adrenaline this sport mode gave you and wanted to supercharge that even further! We found that volleys could get quite predictable with to-and-froing between 2 skilled players so we wanted to add an element that made it more difficult with each return of the ball. So we made the ball build up velocity with each impact! This meant that the longer the volley goes on the more speed and power it picks up making it harder and harder to manage and even more rewarding to return!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/e2f2526a5f4d719293a1225a16f788f0b7099b05.gif[/img]

[h3]Skill Level[/h3]

We were super happy with how this sport was developing and as developers, it was easily one of our favorites! However, as we started taking this to consumer-facing events across the U.K. to see how players interacted with our game we quickly realized that Volleyball had a higher skill cap than other sports, like Football. We saw players fumbling a little more and sometimes not even managing to get it over the net - therefore not even getting to experience the fun we were having as skilled players. Furthermore, it was the first sport on our menu list so was the most frequently picked as well!

We did a few things to combat this! Firstly we put football top of the list which almost acted as a training mode where players could super quickly teach themselves the controls and core concepts of our game before diving into more advanced sports. Secondly, we changed the spawn position of the ball so that it was closer to the net for that first serve. With these 2 simple changes, we saw people being more confident with the game as a whole and more importantly having more fun! We were okay with some sport modes being more challenging than others so we didn’t want to make any drastic changes but we also wanted everyone to have the most positive experience they could when hopping into our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/a9ba682dc5e181b12af6cc710d1f90b81d652df1.gif[/img]

[h3]Character Shapes & Volleyball[/h3]

Another one of our core concepts that shines on this sport mode is that all our characters are different shapes. Volleyball forces more aerial gameplay where you need to anticipate the angle the ball is coming in so the character you choose will drastically change how you are able to return that ball! We wanted to give players a whole roster of different character shapes so that when they hop into a sport they need to carefully think about what character they are best at playing but also what character they are best at playing on that sport!

Following on from this, another thing we noticed through watching players play at events was that there was no consistency with which character shape people chose for different sports. Everyone had their own playstyles and reasons for choosing characters in different matchups which were exactly what we wanted! Where one player may struggle using Square’s flat edges on volleyball another player would use it to their advantage and dominate! The player choice was so important for us so that there were infinite possibilities of matchups where players could learn what works best for them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/0d864a8267a6e4c4d3338398b426c3521095a0e5.gif[/img]

[h3]Special Moves & Volleyball[/h3]

Something else we developed with this sport was the concept of special moves. Not only would you choose your character shape but you would also choose a special move to go with it! We developed these to offer slight but not guaranteed advantages to players that they could build up over time and choose to utilize! We designed these to help balance the disadvantages you may feel that a character shape has and offer a lifeline at, particularly intense moments. Below you can see Eggasaur using a small cake mine to save their opponent from scoring in volleyball and return the ball instead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/34f0fd8b96b6ed5b52b02ef348e451ad5fd80742.gif[/img]

[h3]Volleyball Prototype[/h3]

Volleyball has been pivotal to the wider design of Squishy Sports but we hope this also highlights the importance of getting your game in players’ hands as soon as possible! Below you can see where it all started with the initial prototype right through to where it is at now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/8b80bad9983de2a6aa516e4b32740a696bace990.gif[/img]

Thanks so much for reading - we can’t wait to get out to more consumer-facing shows! More news on that coming soon . . . ! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/d70e1005a14fb2f3a85e37c33968d66f764e2c68.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update #5 - Football Sport Showcase
notes.content:
Football is a sport that is loved by millions around the world! It gives people a sense of pride and belonging in their local teams - no matter how big or small. It unites nations globally on events like the Euros or the World Cup even in the toughest of times! So how could we not have it in Squishy Sports?! :D

Football in Squishy Sports has one of the lowest barriers to entry with its largely horizontal gameplay. It is also a sport that most people recognize meaning that most players can easily understand how it functions with little direction from us! They spawn on either side of the screen with a goal at the other end and instantly know that’s where the ball needs to go! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/0dd181d5cbb641635875c7800eae0a711f10068e.gif[/img]

One of our goals with Squishy Sports is to get as many members of the family involved - even if they are typically non-gamers! In football, you can get involved with just using the analog stick in the direction of the ball or taking it up a notch slightly and using the simple jump button to start adding a tiny bit of complexity. This simple movement and one button input feel great meaning that Grandma, Grandad, your little brother, or sister can easily get involved and play a video game together!

On the flip side, when skilled friends get together they will be able to utilize all our controls from double jump to directional dash paired with the choice of character shape and special moves that make for some ridiculously fun, competitive matchups! This level of choice is what builds the layers of complexity in Squishy Sports and creates that low barrier to entry for anyone who wants to get involved but also scales up quickly for those who are more confident!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/f887b3bb6b0a949db2cb0f81aba0af9f5e590e50.gif[/img]

The physics-driven gameplay drives many aspects of Squishy Sports. In this gif below you can see how the crossbar impacts the goal causes it to react! There are 4 animations (soft, medium, hard & extreme hits) that are triggered based on the velocity of the ball to give that handcrafted, visual feedback that feels responsive and juicy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/e6e8b1d08efa21ea87f213b53802129e4778251c.gif[/img]

This is our first prototype of Football that perfectly captured that fun factor we were aiming for : 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/b4b90001d02a97e8aa7d6355cb52480ecbdf077c.gif[/img]

Fast-forward to now and we have supercharged that same fun factor paired with our full roster of character shapes and special moves all skinned in our beautiful art to create our unique flavour of 2d Football!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/ed801e34f3280331472aef71932704c1761c0aa1.gif[/img]

Thanks for reading - we can’t wait to get one of the most popular sports in Squishy Sports into your hands soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/413fda7c0a7bd6e504ec6d3c056a2fab3283f5bb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update #4 - Introducing...... Environment Hazards!!!
notes.content:
In this update, we really wanted to add more gameplay and add unique mechanics to each environment - we did this during the environmental overhaul stage as it made sense to give each environment a purpose whilst we were designing them.... and I'd love to show you some of these today!!

[h1]Mucky Marsh[/h1]

Introducing.....THE SWAMP MONSTER. This gruesome glob lives in our swamp and doesn't really like folks hanging around.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/0403efe5bcde09b4cccb897cf219976cc7c336e8.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/0403efe5bcde09b4cccb897cf219976cc7c336e8.gif[/img][/url]

They will pop out of the swamp at random intervals to throw sludge at your screen and obscure your vision for a few seconds! In playtesting we've really found this changes the pace of the game, especially if players can't see a thing! 

[h1]Sunrise Sands [/h1]

Introducing.....CAPTAIN BAM BAM.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/283d02caf9aa1d8702a88026c570ec6b53dea9aa.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/283d02caf9aa1d8702a88026c570ec6b53dea9aa.gif[/img][/url]

YARRR! Captain Bam Bam will launch huge cannonballs from their ship.... into the play area! They get in the way - you can push them but they're heavy too!

What do you think? We'd love to hear more from you all on this! Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?!

notes.title: Dev Update #2 - Fan Art In Squishy Sports
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/9f9237a08a67b074654d89f5d5b3e319c2345048.png[/img]

We've put our first fan-designed character into the game - and made a young kid and his family's day by doing so! 😁

At events, we usually run a "create your own character" station - allowing players to design a Squishy Sports character themselves! This has always been a blast and we've always had some great entries.

At the last Yorkshire Games Fest (Before the world turned upside down), we told players we would choose a special character and put them in the game - and we finally did just that. Well... we did! We've followed this design and this has spurred on a wave of design passes that we've done on each environment to add more interactivity as the pirate does in the scene below (We spoke about this on the last post, so check it out if you haven't!).

Creating a family-friendly game, centered around friends and families being able to play together at any skill level has been so so rewarding. And being able to put player designs into our game is even better 😊

Introducing Captain Bam Bam! Our first stage hazard for Sunrise Sands. We'll talk some more about what Captain Bam Bam does and what unique gameplay they bring to our beach environment...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/631c956c72c48f3def9191f8319b09baf4605957.png[/img]

What do you think? Shall we do more of this? This isn't something we want to do absolutely loads of - as it's a lot of work, but we feel that this is something extra special we could do. We'd love to find ways of getting some more fan art into the game somehow!

Have you added us to your wishlist yet? If you haven't, consider it for some Squishy action!

notes.title: Dev Update #1 - Environmental Art OVERHAUL!
notes.content:
We've been BUSY BUSY BUSY over the last few months overhauling our environments,

We'd love to share a few of these changes with you and give you a bit of an insight to our creative and technical decisions.

We wanted to bring even more life to our environments and bring a greater balance to the foreground and background elements. We wanted to retain our epic 'Saturday morning cartoon' aesthetic but draw a clear line between play areas and background elements. We did this by removing the black outlines from background assets and leaving them in the foreground to make them really bold. 

[h1]Mucky Marsh[/h1]
Mucky Marsh was an environment that we felt didn't quite hit the mark the first time around although in concept was absolutely solid. We took the core concept of a sludgy, stinky, and overgrown swamp and reworked the assets to add to this. Reeds and grass now shoot up from the slimy water, fog hangs around the scene, fireflies buzz around the vegetation and a smelly swamp monster awaits to surface beneath the dank pond.

[h3][b]Old[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/8d2a81e749f7194d40a5c238424893cdf07b869f.png[/img]
[h3][b]New[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/6b2378a4fe7bbe9c0591fc4245db1b95286f5f00.png[/img]


[h1]Sunrise Sands [/h1]
Sunrise Sands, again was the first environment we ever designed and we wanted to give this a lot of love in the rework! The biggest additions here were the shark that dives in and out of the waves and the old sea dog captain BamBam that forms part of the stage hazard. This went from an environment that felt a little blame to one that was now teaming with life!

[h3][b]Old[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/ec7cbc8e88c01ea35b2f185792f2a8f2cdac9295.png[/img]
[h3][b]New[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38888819/f59b0c9bd6c5a6ff2ccefd2bb93cfac5fa0723f5.png[/img]

What do you think? We'd love to hear.

Each environment has it's own hazard - so we've got loads more we can't wait to share and talk about! 

We'll also be doing a follow-up post that covers more on the gameplay aspect of these environments and what players can expect from these new "stage hazards"!
